title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 5.19
exact_target: Historical question: can a meromorphic disc function without any asymptotic value still omit a value near one boundary point? The source update reports examples.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2305019 (AMR-022-5019). CC BY 4.0.
